_about: Ranked OpenRouter free models for council.py. Best first. Council seats take the top entries, one per family; when a model fails (upstream 429, downtime, removed) the next unused entry takes its place. Free models churn: run `python council.py --check-models` to see which are gone and which new ones appeared.
_chairman: "claude" = the Claude session running the skill writes the final answer (free, strongest model). Put an OpenRouter model ID here, or pass --chairman <id>, to have the script synthesize instead.

_excluded.stealth/space-bunny-alpha: stealth model: prompts are logged by the anonymous provider, and it vanishes without notice
_excluded.inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash: priced 0 but has no :free suffix: launch promo that can turn paid silently
_excluded.poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free, poolside/lag: coding-agent specialists, weak at open-ended judgement
_excluded.liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b:free: 2.6B, 8K output: too small for a council seat
